item.title: Evidence sent to the WHO review of nicotine
item.description: The WHO's upcoming review of nicotine could have significant implications for the future of tobacco harm reduction. (Published on November 12, 2026bysubstack.com)

item.title: French Senate blocks nicotine vape starter
item.description: A proposal to ban nicotine vape starter packs in France has been blocked on procedural grounds, preventing a new restriction on products used by adults seeking alternatives to cigarettes. (Published on November 12, 2026byclearingtheair.eu)
